service.description: Re-checks one finding's record now: its check runs for that record only, each system read by key, and the ledger closes the finding if the problem is gone or refreshes it with today's cause. Submitted to the background; get#AuditFinding shows the result once lastChecked moves. Writes no check run, so the check's health and its next read are unchanged.

parameter.name: findingId
parameter.description: The finding's id, e.g. F-100794.

service.description: DAR-UI-085. What the audit's checks are doing right now, for its page's Run health while a play or the morning run is going: each automation with a run in progress or queued, the checks it feeds, its stage and progress, and whether it looks healthy, slow or stuck (slow against its own last successful run). Cheap enough to poll; the page reloads the report when a check finishes.

parameter.name: audit
parameter.description: The audit's code.

parameter.name: progress

service.description: DAR-UI-086. "Retry from last read": one check that did not run on one morning is run again from the extracts that morning's run already read (retry#AutomationExecutionFromExtracts), so no system is read again; its findings land on that morning's report. Refused, in words, when it ran already, has no run that morning, or a read did not finish (then play the audit).

parameter.name: audit
parameter.description: The audit's code.

parameter.name: check
parameter.description: The check's code, e.g. completed-not-billed.

parameter.name: date
parameter.description: The morning, YYYY-MM-DD; blank is today in the tenant's zone.

parameter.name: period
parameter.description: The report's period, e.g. 2026-10.

parameter.name: extracts
parameter.description: [{side, fileName, recordCount}] replayed.

service.description: Play: runs every check of the audit now over the days picked, first to last inclusive (the tenant's zone), recording findings as the morning run does. Submitted to the background, one automation per run; the audit page shows the results as each finishes. Refused up front for days in the future or in a period that ended and was not extended.

parameter.name: audit
parameter.description: The audit's code.

parameter.name: fromDate
parameter.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD.

parameter.name: thruDate
parameter.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

parameter.name: fullRead
parameter.description: DAR-BE-122. Read every system for the whole of the days picked. Off: each check reads the days since its last complete read and re-checks its older open findings by key.

parameter.name: runs
parameter.description: [{automationId, savedRunId, submitted, queued, error}]; queued: the run waits for a free slot (DAR-BE-143) and starts on its own.

set.from: darpan.facade.common.TenantAccessSupport.requireActiveTenantWriteAccess(ec, 'Your active tenant only has view access for running audits.')

service.description: What the add-a-check editor offers for one audit: its statements, the tenant's runs with their rules and conclusions, the row types and fix systems a check may name, and the audit's checks.

Creates or updates a check (check.id is its code) and replaces its links to this audit's statements. All or nothing; refused in words for a statement outside the audit, a run the tenant does not own, a rule not in that run, or a row type the ledger does not write. A new check, or one whose run changed, has no automation until the audit's play or settings makes one.

parameter.name: statements
parameter.description: [{id: statement code, diffTypes, conclusionCodes, ruleIds}], at least one (refused in words when empty).
